job.question: In the Q&A for an external audit RFP for a retirement system whose general ledger system is Microsoft Dynamics SL, what were the total contractual fees for the prior year (FY2021) audits?
job.expected_facts: $73,000 (Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System, RFP 515-22-300 Q&A).
job.acceptance: $73,000 for FY2021 audits suffices; issuer/RFP number optional.

reviews.reason: This is Santa Barbara County Employees’ Retirement System’s 2024 global custody RFP, not the external audit RFP Q&A. It provides no total contractual fees for FY2021 audits; its pricing tables solicit proposed custody fees.
quotes: Request for Proposal Global Custody and Related Services Santa Barbara County Employees’ Retirement System (“SBCERS”) Issue Date: January 8, 2024

The primary purpose of this RFP is to identify the most qualified firm to provide global custodial services, accounting services, performance measurement / analytics, and other services to SBCERS as defined in this RFP.
All Respondents shall provide electronic copies in MS Excel (may be sent via e- mail to the designated contacts) of their completed price proposal (Appendix 4).
